Elaine: heads-up — link-scan found ~28 broken anchors under /runtime/guides. thinking a 1-hr batch edit tomorrow 10am PT. who can take point? cc @Dinesh
DocsBot: automated-link-scan: 28 failures in docs/runtime. summary -> https://internal/reports/scan/1707070707
Dinesh: I can take lead. will split by subfolders, can own runtime/kv-cache and runtime/pagination.
Sam: I can triage images and examples, will open PRs for quick 404 fixes. ETA end of day.
Maria: do we have a priority list? which ones cause user-facing regressions vs stale anchors?
Elaine: prioritize ones referenced by quickstart and API snippets (see DocsBot report). minor anchors ok for next sprint. use this ripgrep to find anchors: ```rg "\\#(runtime|quickstart).*" -n docs | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u```
Dinesh: noted. I'll create a tracking issue and assign PRs. ping @Sam for CRs.
Sam: ack. will queue reviews in the morning and mark WIP in PR titles with [docs-batch].
Elaine: thanks — please drop PR links in this thread once opened. I'll also update the KB owners doc after edits :thumbsup:
